description: Two-tier console ACLs: catalog ACL (inner tier) per console and ACL type, can only restrict the file ACLs further (docs/plans/ACL-ZWEISTUFIG.md)
author: Onesimus

tables.name: onesimus_console_acl
tables.description: Inner tier of the two-tier console ACLs: one row per console, ACL type and entry; evaluated like a Bareos ACL list (first match decides, ! negation, regex, *all*). Written only by odir (.acl set/delete/clear/copy).

columns.name: acl_type
columns.description: job, client, storage, schedule, pool, command, fileset, catalog, where, pluginoptions

columns.name: position
columns.description: Evaluation order within (console, acl_type), starting at 0

columns.name: entry
columns.description: As in the configuration file: name, regex, !negation, *all*
